During starting, the "ABS" and "handbrake" warning lights come on simultaneously and stay on for over 4 seconds. (after the initial test on the control unit, both warning lights should go out)

The "low brake fluid" and "handbrake on" warning light, if it comes on together with the "ABS" warning light, indicates a fault in the function

Under these conditions, when the brakes are operated, the rear wheels may lock and the car may skid, as the system's EBD function is temporarily deactivated

If it comes on by itself, this means that the handbrake is on or that the brake fluid level is low
